title: neottia nidus-avis f. pallida
intro: Neottia nidus-avis f. pallida, commonly known as a pale bird's nest orchid, is a type of plant species in the family Orchidaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Neottia nidus-avis f. pallida include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, suggesting its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
